title: Adopting a Label: Heterogeneity in the Economic Consequences Around IAS/IFRS Adoptions

scopes.description: Full author workflow for the paper cannot be established from this data-only archive. The author-prepared IAS/IFRS firm-year dataset is present, but the package supplies no executable analysis workflow or entry point.

requirements.description: The author-described voluntary IAS/IFRS firm-year dataset supplied with the package. The README documents the dataset fields, but with no analysis program the exact fields, period, and any additional inputs consumed by the paper's analyses are unknown.

routes.description: The author-described .dta is included and the bounded probe reports it readable with all 18 listed columns. The probe reads one row and does not establish full-period coverage; the package does not state the analysis period or show whether any other inputs are consumed.

issues.description: The archive inventory contains two documentation PDFs and one Stata dataset, but no executable script or project container. No author analysis can be attempted from the supplied package.

Without executable code or a complete run procedure, the author's analysis entry points, required inputs beyond the supplied dataset, transformations, software, stage order, and reported-output mapping are unknown. The README and coding appendix describe historical construction of the attached hand-coded dataset; those collection sources are not treated as live inputs absent a workflow that requires their reuse.

evidence.description: The README identifies the attached dataset as the result of hand-collection and hand-coding of firms' annual reports and provides the dataset field descriptions.
evidence.quote: extensive hand-collection and hand-coding of firms’ annual reports

evidence.description: The appendix describes the authors' manual coding based on annual reports as historical data-construction procedure.
evidence.quote: we decided to give priority to our manual coding based on firms’ actual

evidence.description: Supplied bounded Stata-file probe: readable, 18 columns reported, one row read, and coverage_verified is false.
Bounded extraction inventory records exactly three archive members: the data-description PDF, coding-appendix PDF, and the .dta file.
The supplied bounded static audit inventories the three documentation/data files, has no entry points, and reports no supported code.

actions.description: Obtain the authors' runnable programs for the reported analyses or a complete documented manual/GUI procedure. Request the actual entry points, ordered stages, each required input and transformation, required software/version, and mapping from stages to the paper's reported outputs. Clarify whether the annual-report and database materials described as sources for historical dataset construction must be reacquired by any supplied execution stage; retain them as provenance unless the workflow establishes a current dependency.
steps: Ask the authors to provide the executable scripts/project or, for a manual or GUI process, all steps needed to reproduce the reported analyses from the supplied dataset.
Request the documented execution order, any additional input files and required fields/periods, transformations, software and versions, and which outputs correspond to each reported table or figure.

After receiving the workflow, reassess every input and producer-consumer dependency; define a separate analysis-only scope only if the authors document an analysis entry point using the supplied dataset.
validation: Confirm every mandatory workflow stage and input has an identified producer or verified compatible route, and that producer-consumer order is documented.
Confirm all reported tables and figures are mapped to reproducible output artifacts and that a later authorized run can be checked against the paper.

review_notes: No analysis_only scope is recorded because this archive contains no analysis entry point or separate documented analysis route; inferring one would invent the authors' workflow.
The attached author-prepared dataset is assessed as the supplied input. Its hand-collection history does not by itself require live acquisition of annual reports or historical source databases.
